verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.treasuryprime.com that indexes the developer docs. Its entries link to markdown (.md) versions of each page, such as getting-started.md, so an agent can be pointed at it and ingest clean docs. Missing for 10: any evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-oriented guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the standard paths (all probed paths returned 404).
